ranking.description: Ensure highlights are ranked based on multi-source data scoring.
criteria: Score alignment with viewer engagement metrics.

filtering.description: Verify filtering logic for game, streamer, category, and score.
criteria: No missing or incorrectly filtered records.

source_coverage.description: Ensure all input sources are utilized effectively.
criteria: Inclusion of platform logs, chat analytics, and manual annotations.

duplicate_noisy_input_handling.description: Detect and handle duplicate or noisy inputs.
criteria: Filtering of irrelevant or low-quality data.

export_shape.description: Validate the structure and content of exported highlight lists.
criteria: Inclusion of all required fields (title, timestamps, rationale).

output_contract.ranked_highlights: Array of ranked highlight objects with detailed metadata.
output_contract.export_cut_list: Array of clip/export rows with timestamps and rationale.
output_contract.quality_checks: Object defining checks for ranking, filtering, source coverage, duplicate/noisy input handling, and export shape.
output_contract.input_summary: Summary of imported data including record counts and source types.
